title: agent-session-grep Handoff Pack v1
description: A versioned, reproducible context handoff pack. JSON is authoritative; the Markdown form is a deterministic projection of this structure (ADR: handoff-pack/v1). Entity id patterns permit [A-Za-z0-9._:-] after the prefix: a native id adopts the provider's own identifier verbatim (StableId::native strips only control characters), and provider identifiers routinely contain hyphens -- a Claude Code message id is a UUID. The earlier [A-Za-z0-9]+ patterns rejected the tool's own real output.

pack_id.description: Deterministic pack identifier derived from generation + query + filters + budget.

catalog_generation.description: The catalog generation pinned when the pack was assembled.

generation_mode.description: How the pack was generated. Current builds emit deterministic only (PRD Q44 default: no model calls); local-LLM summaries would mark local_llm.

created_at.description: Deterministic ISO-8601 UTC timestamp derived from the pinned catalog generation (fixed base + generation seconds). The same generation/query/budget always yields the same value, so packs are byte-reproducible.

matched_sessions.description: Sessions matched by the query, ordered by relevance.

mainline.description: Mainline expansion: the canonical linear message view selected from the message graph.

evidence.description: Original-text evidence spans. Never mixed with inference.

inference.description: LLM-generated or derived summaries. Every entry MUST be marked inference; never placed in evidence. ALWAYS EMPTY when generation_mode is "deterministic", which is the only mode current builds emit: no model is called, so there is nothing to infer. A non-empty list requires a local-LLM generator that marks generation_mode "local_llm"; no released build ships one. Consumers must not treat an empty inference list as a missing summary.

target.description: Declared target provider/agent for the handoff. asg only emits the pack and suggested commands; it never injects into another agent.

time_window.description: Half-open time window [since, until) applied to the query, projected from the query filters. Null when neither bound is set.

provenance.description: Pack provenance: the single provider/session the pack came from. Present only when exactly one session matched the query; absent when zero or several matched, because a multi-session pack genuinely has no single origin. provider_id comes from that session's stored resume claim and is omitted when the store holds no claim for it — the session is reported without the provider, never with a guessed one.

tool_activity.description: Structured tool activity for the messages that produced the evidence, read from the catalog tool_activities projection (store schema v12). Omitted when those messages have no recorded activity — for example a store built before v12, or a session with no tool calls.

source_locators.description: Source document locators (cursor/path references for evidence back-tracing). Never raw transcript paths in cross-boundary output.

provider_id.description: Provider the store's resume claim attributes this session to. Omitted when the store holds no claim for it (pre-claim rows, conflicting claims) — never guessed.

relevance_score.description: Backend-relative relevance, higher is more relevant. NOT normalised and NOT bounded to 0..1: the value is derived from the search backend's own score (BM25 for the lexical path), which is only meaningful when comparing entries within one result set. Do not compare across queries, across retrieval modes, or against a fixed threshold. The bound this field previously declared was wrong -- real packs emit values above 1 -- and normalising instead would invent a scale the backend does not provide.
